2609.30967.title: MoMHa: Multi-Objective Optimization of LLM Harnesses over Accuracy, Safety, and Tokens
2609.30967.paper_summary: Most work on improving large language models treats accuracy as the sole objective. We argue that the harness, the Python code surrounding the model that constructs prompts, routes calls, and parses outputs, is a first-class design surface whose quality is inherently multi-objective: an accurate harness that refuses no unsafe request, or that consumes an order of magnitude more tokens, is not a good harness. We present Meta-Harness, a system that casts harness design as search over three per-domain objectives (accuracy, behavioural safety, and token cost) solved by an agentic proposer (Claude Code) with full filesystem access to prior harness source, execution traces, and scoring artifacts. Our central finding is that a singlephase joint-reward proposer (MoMHa) outperforms every alternative, including a two-phase "accuracy then tokens" ablation, scalar-only feedback, and an accuracy-only baseline. We evaluate on seventeen domains: seven synthetic capability suites, seven real-world public benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, Spider, FEVER, MMLU-Pro, LawBench, NuminaMath), and three U-SafeBench-derived user-specific safety domains, using a 12-model fleet spanning four families. On the synthetic track MoMHa achieves a joint mean of 0.482 versus 0.198-0.422 for ten baselines, winning $7 / 10$ per-domain columns; on the real-world track it scores 0.461 versus 0.377 for the strongest baseline (DSPy), winning 5/7 columns, demonstrating that harness strategies transfer to unseen benchmarks without retraining on 8 of 12 target models. MoMHa attains the highest measured behavioral safety composite (U-SafeBench, 0.781) and uses 95 fewer tokens per example than the two-phase alternative. We will release all harness code, evaluation infrastructure, and crossmodel logs.
2609.30967.paper_summary_zh: 大多數改善大型語言模型的工作將準確性視為唯一目標。我們認為，鞍具，即圍繞模型的 Python 代碼，用於構建提示、路由調用和解析輸出，是一個一流的設計表面，其質量本質上是多目標的：一個拒絕任何不安全請求或消耗數量級更多標記的準確鞍具，並不是一個好的鞍具。我們提出了 Meta-Harness，一個將鞍具設計視為三個每個領域目標（準確性、行為安全性和標記成本）之間的搜索的系統，這些目標由一個具有完整文件系統訪問權限的代理提議者（Claude Code）解決，該提議者可以訪問先前的鞍具源代碼、執行跟蹤和評分工件。我們的核心發現是，單階段聯合獎勵提議者（MoMHa）超越了所有替代方案，包括兩階段的「準確性然後標記」消融、僅標量反饋和僅準確性的基準。我們在十七個領域進行評估：七個合成能力套件、七個現實世界公共基準（HumanEval、MBPP、Spider、FEVER、MMLU-Pro、LawBench、NuminaMath）和三個 U-SafeBench 衍生的用戶特定安全領域，使用一個跨越四個家族的 12 模型艦隊。在合成軌道上，MoMHa 的聯合均值為 0.482，而十個基準的均值為 0.198-0.422，贏得了每個領域的 $7 / 10$ 列；在現實世界軌道上，它的得分為 0.461，而最強基準（DSPy）的得分為 0.377，贏得了 5/7 列，顯示鞍具策略可以在不重新訓練的情況下轉移到未見的基準上，適用於 12 個目標模型中的 8 個。MoMHa 達到了最高的行為安全性綜合測量（U-SafeBench，0.781），並且每個示例使用的標記比兩階段替代方案少 95 個。我們將發布所有鞍具代碼、評估基礎設施和跨模型日誌。
